clauses.title: The terminal report names the run roots the run retained
requires: After any cleanup, the report and any drafted artifacts name each run root this run created and did not see removed
a `workspace_create` `root` or error `details.root` whose cleanup did not run, failed, or returned a non-null `retainedRoot`
and their count; no other root is listed or counted (CL-D78)

clauses.title: CL-D78 records report-only handling of retained run roots
clauses.section: ## CL-D78 — A run reports the run roots it retained
requires: Sweeping, expiring, or listing roots other runs created requires a new owner decision
The list is taken after any cleanup
resets from 260,000 to 270,000 bytes on the CL-D37 review recorded here

clauses.title: A failed create names the run root it kept
requires: Issue #143 a failed create under an explicit run root names that root
Issue #143 a create refused before any root exists names none
